scope: Offline architectural candidate; never apply to Neon without separate owner approval and independent review

roles.purpose: Own protected schema objects and keep ownership inaccessible to routine users
Read/write only reviewed application relations through narrow grants
Execute only approved migration hashes under a supervised, bounded elevation
Independently verify signed/append-only DDL trail with external retention
Perform backup/restore exercises in isolated environment
Only actor able to authorize privileged maintenance and role grants

mandatory_controls.evidence: Verify runtime has no ownership, membership inheritance or SET ROLE path to protected owner or privileged intermediary
Acknowledge ALTER and DROP are intrinsic object-owner capabilities; a schema-owning executor can bypass guards during its elevation
Require reviewed SQL hash, reviewed affected-object allowlist, time limit, separate approval, no shared credential, expiration and postflight
Prove outside-DB collector records BEGIN, attempted and failed/rolled-back DDL as well as committed DDL where supported
Prove source DB privileged principal cannot alter external collector retention, delete events or replace verification secret
End-to-end event continuity, order/sequence, timestamps, event/actor/db identity, durable receipts, integrity checks and loss alert
Prove no blind spots for privileged manual SQL, changes outside approved controller, errors and transaction rollbacks
Confirm features available on owner's Free project with no charge; vendor OTLP/log export might require paid Scale and must not be activated
Separate Neon org/project editor permissions, API tokens and DB SQL roles; neither alone proves the other is constrained
Verify hostname TLS certificate, secret storage, expiry/revocation and rotation including negative connection tests
Restore independently outside same database from verified snapshot, not merely branch history or a provider claim
Require independent PostgreSQL/security review and scientific-governance approval where domain policy applies
